name: Okinawa Slave Island
original_name: 沖縄スレイブアイランド
source: You play the role of a man who is shipped off to Okinawa by his boss and takes advantage of the remoteness of one of the islands of Okinawa and builds a slave island, capturing men and chaining them up for his pleasure.
translation: 玩家扮演一名被上司派往冲绳的男子。他利用冲绳某座岛屿地处偏远的特点，把那里建成“奴隶岛”，抓来男人锁上锁链，供自己享乐。
